maintenance.title: Maintenance services
maintenance.description: Manage visibility, frequencies, and EUR prices for the three fixed services.
maintenance.readOnly: You have view access but cannot change the services.
maintenance.technicalPricing: Technical maintenance has no editable amount. The public price-after-inspection wording is managed by the application.

isActive.label: Publicly visible
isActive.help: Hidden services are excluded from the public read interface.

oneTimeAvailable.label: One-time service
oneTimeAvailable.help: Allows the service to be presented as a one-time option.

periodicAvailable.label: Periodic service
periodicAvailable.help: Periodic maintenance is arranged after consultation and is not an online subscription.

oneTimePrice.label: One-time price
oneTimePrice.help: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places. Comma and dot separators are accepted.

periodicPrice.label: Periodic price
periodicPrice.help: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimal places. Comma and dot separators are accepted.

validation.required: Enter a price for the enabled frequency.
validation.frequency: An active service must offer at least one frequency.

results.INVALID_INPUT: Review the marked fields and try again.
results.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to make this change.
results.NOT_FOUND: The service is no longer available.
results.STALE: The service changed in the meantime. Reload the page before continuing.
results.INCOMPLETE_FIXED_SET: The fixed service set has not been initialized completely.
